name: Fairquery Agent Trust & Data Safety
description: PII and secret redaction/restore, email syntax and deliverability checks, sanctions screening (OFAC, EU, UK, UN) and OSV.dev vulnerability lookups for AI agents. Free tools run locally or query public sources without an account; optional paid tools run the matching Apify Actors on the user's own Apify account.
author: Fairquery

APIFY_TOKEN.description: Optional. Your own Apify API token, only needed for the paid tools (billed to your Apify account). Free tools work without it.
